record.question: What is the purpose of breast compression during mammography ?
options: To make the breast look smaller in the image
To immobilize the breast and spread out the tissue for better imaging
record.explanation: Official final key: C — To immobilize the breast and spread out the tissue for better imaging. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 8, printed Q69. Source limitation: More than one listed option is a valid purpose of breast compression. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
